requirements.description: Vitest is installed and configured for the project
steps: Check package.json for vitest dependency
Verify vitest is installed in node_modules
Review vitest.config.ts configuration file
Confirm test environment is set to 'happy-dom' or 'jsdom'
Verify configuration extends Nuxt's default config

requirements.description: @nuxt/test-utils is properly configured
steps: Verify @nuxt/test-utils is installed
Check nuxt.config.ts for testUtils module configuration
Review test-utils configuration in vitest.config.ts
Confirm setup files include Nuxt test utils setup
Verify nuxt-shim is properly configured

requirements.description: Test scripts added to package.json
steps: Verify 'test' script runs vitest
Check 'test:unit' script exists for unit tests only
Verify 'test:ui' script opens Vitest UI
Confirm 'test:coverage' script runs with coverage
Check 'test:ci' script exists for CI with proper flags

requirements.description: Test files follow co-located naming convention
steps: Verify spec files use .spec.ts extension
Confirm test files are next to source files (Component.vue + Component.spec.ts)
Check composables have corresponding .spec.ts files
Verify utilities have corresponding .spec.ts files
Ensure test files are excluded from production builds

requirements.description: Coverage reporting is configured with v8 provider
steps: Verify @vitest/coverage-v8 is installed
Review coverage configuration in vitest.config.ts
Confirm coverage reports to coverage/ directory
Check coverage includes all source files appropriately
Verify coverage excludes test files and config files

requirements.description: Coverage thresholds are configured but not enforced
steps: Review coverage thresholds in vitest.config.ts
Confirm thresholds are set to 0 or low values
Verify coverage report generates HTML output
Check coverage report generates text output for CLI
Ensure coverage doesn't block test execution

requirements.description: Test utilities and helpers are created
steps: Verify tests/utils/ directory exists
Check for mountHelper.ts for component mounting
Confirm mockHelpers.ts exists for common mocks
Review databaseTestHelper.ts for DB testing
Verify test utilities are properly exported

requirements.description: Mock utilities for Electron APIs exist
steps: Verify Electron IPC mocks are configured
Check safeStorage mock implementation
Confirm dialog mock for file operations
Review app/window management mocks
Verify mocks are easily importable in tests

requirements.description: Mock utilities for Capacitor plugins exist
steps: Verify @capacitor-community/sqlite mock exists
Check keychain/secure storage mocks
Confirm filesystem plugin mocks
Review network/HTTP plugin mocks
Verify platform detection mocks

requirements.description: Example composable test exists and passes
steps: Verify at least one composable has a .spec.ts file
Check test uses mountSuspended or unit test approach
Confirm test verifies composable behavior
Verify test imports from #imports for auto-imports
Run test and confirm it passes

requirements.description: Example component test exists and passes
steps: Verify at least one Vue component has a .spec.ts file
Check test uses mountSuspended from @nuxt/test-utils
Confirm test renders component correctly
Verify test can interact with component (click, input)
Run test and confirm it passes

requirements.description: Example utility test exists and passes
steps: Verify at least one utility has a .spec.ts file
Check test covers pure function logic
Confirm test includes edge cases
Verify test uses Vitest expect matchers
Run test and confirm it passes

requirements.description: Database testing setup for Drizzle ORM
steps: Verify test database configuration exists
Check in-memory SQLite setup for tests
Confirm migration running in test setup
Review transaction rollback between tests
Verify test helpers for seeding test data

requirements.description: Server API testing utilities exist
steps: Verify setup for testing Nitro server routes
Check supertest or similar HTTP testing setup
Confirm test database isolation for API tests
Review authentication mocking for protected routes
Verify example API test exists and passes

requirements.description: Testing documentation exists in project
steps: Verify TESTING.md file exists in project root
Check documentation covers running tests
Confirm documentation explains test organization
Review section on writing new tests
Verify documentation includes troubleshooting

requirements.description: VS Code extensions recommendations include testing tools
steps: Check .vscode/extensions.json exists
Verify Vitest extension is recommended
Confirm recommended extensions for Vue testing
Review debug configuration for tests in .vscode/launch.json
Verify extension recommendations are helpful

requirements.description: GitHub Actions workflow runs tests on PR
steps: Verify .github/workflows/test.yml exists
Check workflow triggers on pull requests
Confirm workflow runs on main branch pushes
Verify workflow installs dependencies and runs tests
Check workflow uploads coverage reports as artifacts

requirements.description: CI test workflow handles all platforms
steps: Verify workflow runs on ubuntu-latest
Check if macos-latest and windows-latest included
Confirm Node.js version matches project requirements
Review caching strategy for node_modules
Verify workflow completes in reasonable time

requirements.description: AI SDK mocks exist for testing
steps: Verify generateObject mock implementation
Check streamText mock for streaming responses
Confirm mock supports Zod schema validation
Review mock for provider configurations
Verify AI SDK mocks are importable from test utils

requirements.description: Transformers.js mocks exist for embeddings
steps: Verify Transformers.js pipeline mock
Check embedding generation mock returns vector array
Confirm mock handles model loading states
Review error handling mock scenarios
Verify mock doesn't attempt actual model loading in tests

requirements.description: All existing composables have passing tests
steps: Identify all composables in app/composables/
Verify each has a corresponding .spec.ts file
Run all composable tests and confirm pass
Check tests cover happy paths and edge cases
Verify no composables are untested

requirements.description: All existing utilities have passing tests
steps: Identify all utilities in app/utils/
Verify each has a corresponding .spec.ts file
Run all utility tests and confirm pass
Check tests cover function logic thoroughly
Verify no utilities are untested

requirements.description: Critical components have passing tests
steps: Identify critical UI components (ProviderSwitcher, etc.)
Verify each has a corresponding .spec.ts file
Run component tests and confirm pass
Check tests verify component rendering and interaction
Document any components intentionally excluded

requirements.description: Tests run in parallel for fast feedback
steps: Verify vitest.config.ts has parallel test execution
Check that tests don't have race conditions
Confirm database tests use separate connections
Review test duration - should complete in under 30s
Verify watch mode is responsive for development

requirements.description: Test environment doesn't use production secrets
steps: Verify .env.test or test environment config exists
Check that API keys in tests are mock/fake values
Confirm test database is isolated from production
Review that no real LLM calls happen in tests
Verify CI doesn't have access to production secrets

requirements.description: TypeScript types work correctly in tests
steps: Verify tests use TypeScript with strict mode
Check that auto-imports are typed correctly in tests
Confirm Nuxt types are available in test context
Review that component props are typed in tests
Verify no 'any' types without justification
